QUOTE: **Unknown section names are refused.** A misspelled top-level key fails and names the probable cause. Keys with an `x-` prefix are tolerated and ignored. A malformed declaration degrades to defaults.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says unknown sections are refused, but it doesn't say they're refused against the allowed set, and it gives no reason. It never says that ignoring a section would build with defaults while claiming the declaration was honoured.
